resources.string: Reads offer text on-screen to compute $/mile, $/hour, and estimated time. Processes on-device only.

This app uses an Accessibility Service to read the offer text displayed on your screen (for example: payout and miles) so it can calculate $/mile, $/hour, and estimated time. The app does not automate taps, does not accept/decline orders, and does not send offer data off your device. You can disable this anytime in Android Settings.
Reads DoorDash offer screens to calculate $/mile, $/hour, and time.
